mechanism: Graph-based rollout memory used to propagate rewards during RL fine-tuning
evidence_scope: MemReward stores rollouts (thinking processes and final answers) from an initial LLM policy as nodes in a heterogeneous graph connected by similarity and structural edges, over which a GNN propagates rewards from labeled to unlabeled rollouts.
evidence_role: we proposeMemReward, a graph-based experience memory framework that integrates reward propagation directly into online policy optimization.
